title: 逃げゆく風を追いかけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We discuss our strategy for the Japanese Derby. While the track may appeal to Mejiro Bright's strengths, she may find it difficult to establish her own pace there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's when Mejiro Ryan brings in Ines Fujin to partner run with Mejiro Bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Running against an Umamusume skilled in controlling the race helps Mejiro Bright to pin down the timing of her final dash. The training session with her two "big sisters" turns out to be a success.
